name: v2.13.1
body:
# Release notes for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) v2.13.1

[Documentation](https://cluster-api-aws.sigs.k8s.io/)

# Changelog since v2.13.0

## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- Feat(rosa): add `ec2MetadataHttpTokens` field to ROSAControlPlane CRD to allow enforcing IMDSv2 on ROSA HCP cluster EC2 instances (#6265, @andclt)


The images for this release are: `registry.k8s.io/cluster-api-aws/cluster-api-aws-controller:v2.13.1`

Thanks to all our contributors.
